messages:
maria: Heads-up: rook-lite-q8 canary showing low-rate funcall URL failures (~0.3%). Validator complains URLs don't match our regex even though they look fine in logs.
 tom h: Repro locally on streaming path. The model output contains literal backslash characters inserted before '/' characters in URLs at chunk boundaries. After JSON parse the string contains extra backslashes and our URL pattern rejects it. Non-streaming responses are clean.
 jia: Example symptom (redacted): parsed funcall.args.url looks like 'https:\/\/example.com\/foo' where the extra backslashes are not expected by our URL validator. This seems to be double-escaping introduced by tokenized streaming chunks.
 triage-bot: alert: funcall-url-escape-fail 0.31% (rook-lite-q8) over 25k calls
 maria: Hypothesis: quantized token kernels emit a backslash token when a token boundary splits on a slash char; streaming reassembly can duplicate escapes. Also amplified when KV-prefixing introduces extra chunk joins.
 tom h: Short-term mitigation: sanitizer that normalizes URL fields before schema validation. Plan: detect consecutive backslashes before slashes and collapse them, then run urlparse normalization. Also add metric funcall_url_escaped_pct.
 jia: We'll add a canary flag to enable sanitizer for 20% traffic. Also unit tests that simulate chunked token streams producing escape chars.
 maria: Also add a detection rule to surface any URL containing literal double-backslash sequences so we can alert earlier.
 tom h: Experiment plan: run 50k synthetic streaming calls across q8, q4f16, and fp16 with and without KV-cache; bucket by response length and chunk count. Goal: quantify correlation and confirm sanitizer reduces failure to <0.01%.
 jia: Long-term: coordinate with tokenizer/runtime to avoid emitting backslash tokens for slashes; filed internal ISSUE-ml-escape-slash for kernel triage.
 maria: Action items:
- tom h: PR for proxy sanitizer + metric (ETA EOD)
- jia: synthetic 50k job and unit tests (ETA 24h)
- runtime: triage ISSUE-ml-escape-slash (cc)

triage-bot: Monitoring enabled. Will report back when canary data updates.
 maria: Thanks team. Pushing sanitizer to canary now, ping me if anything weird shows up.
